text_block_list.text:
While basking in the thrill of racing, she
sets her
sights on the race that will
decide the junior
champion...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her goal is decided—as the first major
step
towards her dream, she locks her
crosshairs on the
Asahi Hai Futurity
Stakes!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
